messages:
elaine: Quick proposal for today's roadmap decision: introduce a 'Flex Commit' SKU — customers pick a monthly GPU/throughput commit, get a soft overage band (up to 120%) with auto-throttle beyond that and overage billed at a discounted rate. Optional add-ons: extended observability retention (+90 days), private deploy support, and premium SLOs. Need signoff on limits, billing language, and launch criteria before EOW.

migs: +1 from AE side. Key ask: let sales convert proofs-of-value to temporary higher soft caps for 30d without legal review. Helps close big deals faster.

elaine: noted. That would be a sales-triggered temp increase with an explicit opt-in checkbox and audit log. We need a guardrail so it can't go unlimited.

tony: finance perspective: we need a minimum commit threshold for Flex (suggest $5k/month) to avoid churn math flipping. Also want a hard overage cap configurable per-customer to limit exposure. If we do discounted overage, product needs to show unit economics (expected token cost + margin).

liam: engineering flag: soft overage + auto-throttle means more quota-management code and rate-limit state per-customer. Ops cost increases if we allow frequent, high spikes. Suggest: implement soft cap enforcement via token-bucket at the gateway and schedule a single rollout phase for telemetry first.

samira: legal: contract note — 'soft cap' must be clearly defined with exact behavior: throttling -> warnings -> temporary suspension. Also need language on data residency for Private deployments if add-on chosen. No open-ended temporary increases without amendment for >90 days.

elaine: suggested launch criteria (must-have): 1) pricing page + examples, 2) billing & invoice test for overages, 3) e2e throttling tests, 4) legal-approved template clause. Nice-to-have: self-serve temporary increases in console.

liam: plan: Phase 1: telemetry + billing meter (2 sprints), Phase 2: gateway enforcement + UI for soft cap (1 sprint), Phase 3: self-serve temp increase + audit trail (2 sprints). Estimating ~5-6 sprints total.

migs: commercial ask: allow a one-off onboarding credit for first month (e.g., 50% base) to mitigate objections. Also want an explicit 'enterprise overage cap' negotiated line in quotes.

tony: okay to do onboarding credit as promo line item, but it must be classified as one-time discount in billing system. For enterprise deals we should require a minimum 12-month commit or scaled monthly MRR to qualify for lower overage rate.

samira: confirm we will include an SLA fallback for guaranteed latency; any public SLA promises need to map to Dedicated/Private tiers, not Flex.

elaine: decision needed today: minimum commit threshold and default soft cap percentage. Proposed defaults: min commit $5k/mo, soft cap 120% default, discounted overage = 0.8x list. Anything else?

migs: can we make soft cap configurable per-account at signup (sales override)?

liam: technically yes, but initial implementation should keep a single default. Sales override requires UI + audit + roles. Add to Phase 3.

tony: approve defaults with condition: engineering and ops must give final run-rate cost calc before public launch.

samira: legal approves default terms pending final SLA/DR wording. No temporary increases >90 days without amendment.

elaine: great — action items: @liam create run-rate cost estimate by Tue, @migs draft sales playbook language for temporary increases, @tony validate margin model, @samira produce contract clause stub. I'll draft PRD with the phases and launch criteria. Ops-bot: create ticket for roadmap milestone. :white_check_mark:

ops-bot: Created ticket INFR-7893 "Flex Commit SKU - Phase planning" and set due date 2026-04-05.

elaine: thanks — we'll review progress in Friday's roadmap sync. Short follow-up: any objections to soft cap default being 120%?

migs: no objections.

liam: no objections but will push back if cost calc shows unacceptable ops burn.

tony: no objections pending margin check.

samira: no objections.

elaine: cool, locking defaults for PRD. Thanks all.
